seo.title: Appointment confirmed — Alder Health
seo.description: An example confirmation with your visit details, how to plan your arrival and what to bring. Nothing is booked — this is a design demonstration.

intro.title: Your next step is all set.
intro.lead: {firstName}, here are the details for your example {specialty} visit.

notice.title: Example confirmation — no appointment has been booked
notice.copy: This is a fictional booking demonstration. No confirmation email has been sent.

preparation.title: Plan your arrival
preparation.copy: Your example in-person visit is at {clinic}, {address}. Allow time to find the entrance and check in.

preparation.title: Bring your questions
preparation.copy: Have your appointment details and any relevant documents ready. Write down the questions you would like to discuss.

preparation.title: Tell us what would help
preparation.copy: For step-free access or other practical needs, contact the clinic before your visit. Do not send sensitive medical details by general email.

plans.title: Plans change. We’re here to help.
plans.copy: Use View appointments to find the reschedule and cancel actions. For a real visit, check the clinic’s cancellation information or contact the team.
